chunks: Yunus, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
“If a man overpowers a woman against herself, he is struck with a blow of the sword, whether he dies from it or lives.”

key_terms.ضَرْبَةً بِٱلسَّيْفِ: a strike with the sword as the prescribed punishment
key_terms.عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهَا: against her own will or person
key_terms.كَابَرَ: used here in the sense of overpowering or coercing by force
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةَ: the woman who is subjected to the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam for a man who forces a woman sexually?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a man who forces himself upon a woman. It prescribes a severe penal consequence, reflecting the gravity of coercive sexual violation in Islamic jurisprudence.
